records.title: General Comment No. 01: Implementation of article 3 of the Convention in the context of article 22
records.short_title: GC1: Implementation of Art. 3  in the context of Art. 22
records.text: Article 3 is confined in its application to cases where there are substantial grounds for believing that the author would be in danger of being subjected to torture as defined in article 1 of the Convention.

records.title: General Comment No. 01: Implementation of article 3 of the Convention in the context of article 22
records.short_title: GC1: Implementation of Art. 3  in the context of Art. 22
records.text: The Committee is of the view that the phrase “another State” in article 3 refers to the State to which the individual concerned is being expelled, returned or extradited, as well as to any State to which the author may subsequently be expelled, returned or extradited.

records.title: General Comment No. 01: Implementation of article 3 of the Convention in the context of article 22
records.short_title: GC1: Implementation of Art. 3  in the context of Art. 22
records.text: Pursuant to article 1, the criterion, mentioned in article 3, paragraph 2, of “a consistent pattern or gross, flagrant or mass violations of human rights” refers only to violations by or at the instigation of or with the consent or acquiescence of a public official or other person acting in an official capacity.
